headline: Sam Altman says OpenAI won’t go public until its models are safe
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman states the company won't go public yet. IPO depends on achieving better model safety guarantees. No firm timeline is currently in sight for the public offering.

headline: Trump orders US government to call AI ‘Super Intelligence’
summary: President Trump's executive order renames "Artificial Intelligence" to "Super Intelligence." All official US government documents and websites will adopt the new term. Trump cited "super is the best word" for the change.

headline: BMW’s revamped i3 boasts up to 468 miles of range
summary: BMW unveils details for its revamped all-electric i3 sedan. The new i3 will offer an impressive range of up to 468 miles. Built on the Neue Klasse platform, more specs are being revealed.

headline: Suspected ShinyHunters leader arrested in the Netherlands
summary: Dutch police arrested a 24-year-old in Amsterdam. The individual is suspected of leading the ShinyHunters hacking group. ShinyHunters claimed responsibility for attacks on Ticketmaster, Rockstar Games, and the FBI.

headline: 'The Train Isn't Stopping' — Diablo 4 Director Promises the Game Will Still Receive Support Well After Diablo 5 Launches
summary: Diablo 4 director Brent Gibson reassures fans about the game's future. He confirmed continued support for Diablo 4 post-Diablo 5 launch. Concerns about Diablo 4's lifespan arose after the Diablo 5 announcement.

headline: Original God of War Creator Defends Laufey's Creative Director From Harassment After His Critical Remarks Go Viral
summary: Original God of War creator David Jaffe defends Laufey's Creative Director, Ariel Lawrence. Lawrence faced harassment following critical remarks that went viral. Jaffe clarified his own viral comments regarding Lawrence.

headline: GTA 6's Game of the Year Chances Have Been Called Into Question
summary: GTA 6's eligibility for Game of the Year at The Game Awards is under scrutiny. The game's potential release timeline raises questions. Its chances for this year's top award are being debated.

headline: Everything Coming to Amazon Prime Video in October
summary: A comprehensive list of new content for Amazon Prime Video in October. Subscribers can anticipate a fresh lineup of movies and shows. This update covers all upcoming titles for the month.

headline: One of the five men arrested near RAF Fairford called 999 himself
summary: One of the five men arrested near RAF Fairford made a 999 call. The call was placed almost an hour before a farmer reported men in balaclavas. Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the incident.

headline: How did the RAF Fairford incident go from 'suspected bomb plot' to police bail?
summary: The RAF Fairford incident shifted from a suspected bomb plot to police bail. Detectives are in a crucial stage of their investigation. Various options remain open as the inquiry progresses.

headline: Burnham vows to end existing pension triple lock in 2030 to help fund care
summary: PM Burnham pledges to end the current pension triple lock by 2030. The move aims to reallocate funds towards social care. He outlined his long-term plan for the UK in an emotional conference speech.

headline: Chris Mason: Burnham delivers deeply political speech with a personal core
summary: Andy Burnham delivered a deeply political speech with strong personal elements. BBC political editor Chris Mason highlighted its dual nature. The speech reflected both a new prime minister and a grieving son.
